content.purpose: Procure one CNC turning centre for the Manufacturing Lab.
content.initial_context: The Head of Department asked Purchase to collect three quotations (requirement note attached).

discussion_points.text: Three quotations were compared: Vendor A INR 18.4 lakh, Vendor B INR 17.9 lakh, Vendor C INR 19.1 lakh.

The technical committee found Vendor A did not meet the spindle speed range; Vendor B met all mandatory specifications with delivery within eight weeks; Vendor C was compliant with a longer delivery period.
The department recommended Vendor B; the Dean (Administration) approved subject to standard purchase terms and budget confirmation.
Purchase reported that Accounts confirmed budget availability, then sent the purchase order to Vendor B.

latest_status.text: Purchase order sent to Vendor B on 11 September 2026; delivery and installation remain pending.

deadlines.text: Issue purchase order by 11 September 2026 — met (11 Sep 2026)

latest_status.text: 38 certificates are ready for collection; four applications remain on hold pending fee receipts.

answer.question: What happened with the CNC machine procurement?

answer_blocks.text: The Head of Department asked Purchase to collect three technical and commercial quotations for one CNC turning centre for the Manufacturing Lab.
Quotations were Vendor A INR 18.4 lakh, Vendor B INR 17.9 lakh and Vendor C INR 19.1 lakh; Vendor B was lowest, subject to technical compliance.
The technical committee found Vendor A did not meet the spindle speed range and Vendor B met all mandatory specifications with delivery within eight weeks.
The department recommended Vendor B at INR 17.9 lakh. A recommendation is not an approval.
The Dean (Administration) approved on 8 September 2026 for INR 17.9 lakh, subject to standard purchase terms and budget confirmation.
The Purchase section reported that Accounts confirmed budget availability.
The purchase order was sent to Vendor B on 11 September 2026.
Delivery and installation remain pending.

latest_status.text: Purchase order sent; delivery and installation pending.

caveats: No email states a delivery or installation date; the purchase order attachment says delivery is within eight weeks of order confirmation, and the confirmation date is not stated.
